summary: Full Truck Alliance Co. Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to announce its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing contains standard earnings disclosure: total net revenues of RMB2,848.4M (+5.5% YoY), net income of RMB994.1M, and non-GAAP adjusted net income of RMB1,202.0M. Operational metrics show fulfilled orders up 14.3% to 55.0M and average shipper MAUs up 12.7% to 3.11M. There is no transaction, strategic event, or corporate action beyond routine quarterly reporting. This is an ordinary earnings release for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
